ja: 新しいシステムについて、いくつかアドバイスをいただけますか？
en: Could you give me some advice on the new system?
alternatives: Could you give me some advice about the new system?
Can you give me some advice on the new system?
point: advice は数えられないので advices にしない

ja: 昨日送ってもらったメールに、添付ファイルが付いていませんでした。
en: Your email yesterday didn't have the attachment.
alternatives: The attachment wasn't in your email yesterday.
Yesterday's email from you didn't include the attachment.
point: 過去の否定は didn't のあとに動詞の原形 have

ja: あなたがもっと早く在庫の件を教えてくれていたら、私は取引先への返信を遅らせずに済んだのですが。
en: If you had told me about the stock issue earlier, I wouldn't have had to delay my reply to the client.
alternatives: Had you told me about the stock issue sooner, I wouldn't have had to hold off on replying to the client.
If you'd let me know about the stock issue earlier, I wouldn't have needed to delay my reply to the client.
point: 過去の反実仮想は if + had 過去分詞、主節は would have

ja: 来週の打ち合わせの前に、この提案書にざっと目を通しておいてもらえますか？
en: Could you look over this proposal before our meeting next week?
alternatives: Would you mind going over this proposal before our meeting next week?
Could you skim through this proposal before next week's meeting?
point: 「ざっと目を通す」は look over / go over で言える

ja: 取引先からの返信を昨日の朝からずっと待っているんですが、まだ来ないんです。
en: I've been waiting for the client's reply since yesterday morning, but it hasn't come yet.
alternatives: I've been waiting to hear back from the client since yesterday morning, but nothing yet.
I've been waiting for a reply from the client since yesterday morning, and it still hasn't come.
point: ずっと待っている は have been waiting、since で起点

ja: うちの部長は、昨日のメールにどう返信しましたか？
en: How did our manager reply to yesterday's email?
alternatives: What was our manager's reply to yesterday's email?
How did our manager respond to yesterday's email?
point: 過去の疑問文は did を使い、動詞は reply と原形に戻す

ja: 取引先が先週送ってきた見積もりの条件を、彼女がもう確認したかどうか、私には分かりません。
en: I'm not sure whether she's already checked the terms in the quote the client sent us last week.
alternatives: I don't know if she's gone through the terms in the quote the client sent last week yet.
I'm not certain she's checked the terms included in the quote that the client sent us last week.
point: whether 節の中に「先方が送った見積もり」を後ろから付ける

ja: 見積もりを確定するには、今週金曜までに正確な発注数をいただく必要があるのですが。
en: To finalize the quote, we'd need the exact order quantity from you by this Friday.
alternatives: We'd need the exact order quantity from you by this Friday to finalize the quote.
In order to finalize the quote, we'd need your exact order quantity by this Friday.
point: 目的の「〜するには」は To do で文頭に置ける。we'd need で柔らかく

ja: 明日の朝いちばんに私に電話するよう、田中さんに伝えてもらえますか？
en: Could you tell Mr. Tanaka to call me first thing tomorrow morning?
alternatives: Could you ask Mr. Tanaka to call me first thing tomorrow morning?
Can you tell Mr. Tanaka to give me a call first thing tomorrow morning?
point: 「人に〜するよう伝える」は tell + 人 + to do

ja: この件、チャットでやり取りする代わりに、短いオンライン会議をするのはどうですか？
en: How about having a quick online meeting instead of discussing this in chat?
alternatives: What about having a short video call instead of discussing this over chat?
How about holding a quick online meeting instead of going back and forth in chat?
point: How about と instead of の後は動詞の ing 形

ja: メールありがとうございます。私たちは来週の金曜日に御社を訪問する予定です。
en: Thank you for your email. We're visiting your office next Friday.
alternatives: Thank you for your email. We're going to visit your office next Friday.
Thanks for your email. We're planning to visit your office next Friday.
point: 決まった予定は be + ing か be going to で表す

ja: 先方は、請求書を月曜までに送ると言っていましたよ。
en: The client said they would send the invoice by Monday.
alternatives: The client told us they'd send the invoice by Monday.
The client said they were going to send the invoice by Monday.
point: said に合わせて will を would にする

ja: チャットをもらったとき、私はお客さんと話していました。
en: I was talking with a client when you messaged.
alternatives: I was talking to a customer when you messaged me.
When you messaged me, I was speaking with a client.
point: 「話していた」は was talking と過去進行形にする
